SELECT DISTINCT
CEV.CEV_CLM_ID 			AS CLAIM_ID,

FIRST_DAY(SUB.CRS_ADD_TS)    AS ENCOUNTER_SLA_DT_MONTH,
CEV.CEV_ADD_TS 		AS CLAIM_FINALIZED_DATE,
SUB.CRS_ADD_TS      AS ENCOUNTER_SUB_DATE,
DAYS(SUB.CRS_ADD_TS) - DAYS(CEV.CEV_EV_DT) 
						AS ENCOUNTER_SLA_AGE,
CASE 
	WHEN SUB.CRS_ADD_TS BETWEEN CEV.CEV_ADD_TS AND LAST_DAY(CEV.CEV_ADD_TS+ 1 MONTH) THEN 'Yes'
	ELSE 'No'
END 					AS ENCOUNTER_SUBMITTED_TIMELY						

FROM HS.CLM_CLAIM AS CLM
JOIN HS.CEV_CLM_EV AS CEV ON CLM.CLM_ID = CEV.CEV_CLM_ID AND CEV.CEV_DEL_TS IS NULL AND CEV.CEV_RUN_ID IS NOT NULL AND CEV.CEV_RUN_ID !=0 AND TRIM(CEV.CEV_TYPE) IN ('PD','DN') AND (CEV.CEV_ADD_TS = (SELECT CEV_ADD_TS FROM HS.CEV_CLM_EV WHERE CEV_CLM_ID = CEV.CEV_CLM_ID AND CEV_DEL_TS IS NULL AND CEV_RUN_ID IS NOT NULL AND CEV_RUN_ID !=0 AND TRIM(CEV_TYPE) = 'DN' ORDER BY CEV_ADD_TS ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR) 
																																												OR CEV.CEV_ADD_TS = (SELECT CEV_ADD_TS FROM HS.CEV_CLM_EV WHERE CEV_CLM_ID = CEV.CEV_CLM_ID AND CEV_DEL_TS IS NULL AND CEV_RUN_ID IS NOT NULL AND CEV_RUN_ID !=0 AND TRIM(CEV_TYPE) = 'PD' ORDER BY CEV_ADD_TS ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR))
JOIN HS.CDT_CLM_DT       AS CDT ON CEV.CEV_CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
JOIN	HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT	AS SUB ON CLM.CLM_ID = SUB.CRS_CLM_ID AND SUB.CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND SUB.CRS_TYPE IN ('023','024','025','049','050','051') /* AND SUB.CRS_ADDL_INFO IN ('998403440','998403441','998403446','998403447','998403442','998403443','998403448','998403449','998403444','998403445') */
									AND SUB.CRS_ADD_TS = (SELECT CRS_ADD_TS FROM HS.CRS_CLM_RESULT WHERE CRS_DEL_TS IS NULL AND CRS_TYPE IN ('023','024','025','049','050','051') AND SUB.CRS_CLM_ID = CRS_CLM_ID AND CRS_ADD_TS >= CEV.CEV_ADD_TS /*AND CRS_ADDL_INFO IN ('998403440','998403441','998403446','998403447','998403442','998403443','998403448','998403449','998403444','998403445')*/ ORDER BY CRS_ADD_TS ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR)


WITH UR
